notes.title: version 1.4.3 is now live
notes.notes:
This is just a small update to fix some issues that were found on a nother platform that also were in the PC version.

One thing that was fixed that no one said anything about was scrolling the leaderboards.  before you couldn't see passed the 9th entry but now you can scroll all the way to the bottom of the list.

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 now live
notes.notes:
This version adds a feature mainly for those of you looking to increase your leaderboard scores.  Now completing the quests that appear on the right side of the HUD will give you 100 points per task completed when you finish playing a level.  This may or may not be increased or decreased in the future.

Also a special skin has been added in honor of todays Great North American Solar Eclipse.  To get this skin just play and complete one non challenge level or non custom in Swap Blocks.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Released
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 have been rolled out.  Below is a list of what was added.

[list]
[*]PS4 and other Generic controllers can be used with the Steam Controller Configuration.
[*]PS4 Controller prompts.
[*]Locked game modes now show how many stars are needed to be unlocked.
[*]Custom puzzles can now be played in the Cross gameplay mode.
[/list]
